items.title: The naive cotangent complex of an affine chart computes that of the morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For affine opens U of the source and V of the target with U mapping into V, the lemma produces a canonical map from the sheafified naive cotangent complex of the corresponding ring map to the restriction of the naive cotangent complex of the morphism, and shows it is a quasi-isomorphism. The proof compares the two complexes on the affine chart, uses the description of the naive cotangent complex through a presentation of the ring map, and verifies that the comparison is an isomorphism in the derived category. Verifying the quasi-isomorphism after sheafification is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3747-3774.
